cli.usage:
tmcon-cli — thin client for terminal-mode-console / even-terminal

  tmcon-cli 'http://host:3462?token=XXXX'
  tmcon-cli --url http://host:3462 --token XXXX [--session <id>] [--new] [--provider claude|codex] [--cwd <dir>] [--model <name>]

  --cwd <dir>    Filter the list by that working directory (substring match),
                 and start new sessions in that directory.
  --model <name> Model for claude (alias opus/sonnet/haiku/fable/default or a
                 full ID). Switch mid-chat with /model <name>; /model clears it (auto).
                 If omitted, no model is sent; the session/server setting is kept.

  Ctrl+C interrupts the running turn; press again to quit.

local.systemPrompt: You are an assistant running on smart glasses. Because the screen is small, answer concisely, with only the key points. Avoid long preambles and verbose explanations.
local.toolsHint: You can use these tools when needed: bash (run a command), grep (search), read_file (view text), view_image (load a local image), list_dir (list a directory). Call a tool when you want to verify a file or command output, then answer concisely based on the result. If you are a vision-capable model and an image is attached directly to the message, you can recognize it without any external tool. When you can see the image without using an external tool, just answer about it. Use view_image only to open an image file stored locally (not read_file).
local.toolDenied: The user declined to run the tool.
local.imageAttached: ({count} image(s) are attached to this message. Don't call any tool — look at the image(s) directly and answer.)
tools.desc.bash: Run a single shell command and return stdout/stderr. Use it to view files, search, build, etc.
tools.desc.bash.command: The command to run (evaluated with bash -c)
tools.desc.grep: Recursively search under the working directory and return matching lines as 'file:line:content' (read-only).
tools.desc.grep.pattern: The regular expression / string to search for
tools.desc.grep.path: The file/directory to search (defaults to the current directory)
tools.desc.read_file: Return the contents of a text file (read-only).
tools.desc.read_file.path: Path of the file to read (relative to the working directory)
tools.desc.view_image: Load an image file (png/jpg/webp/gif/bmp) so its content can be analyzed visually. Use it to understand diagrams, photos, screenshots, or scans. For text files, use read_file.
tools.desc.view_image.path: Path of the image to read (relative to the working directory)
tools.desc.list_dir: List the contents of a directory (read-only). Directory names get a trailing /.
tools.desc.list_dir.path: The directory to list (defaults to the current directory)
tools.result.unsupportedImage: Unsupported image format ({ext}). Specify one of png/jpg/webp/gif/bmp.
tools.result.imageTooLarge: Image too large ({bytes} bytes > limit {max} bytes). Shrink it before passing it in.
tools.result.imageLoaded: Loaded image {path} ({bytes} bytes). Its content is attached in the next message.
